remarks: Charming 3-story townhouse in Stamford with gorgeous views of Rippowam River. This recently painted home features all hard wood floors and plenty of natural lighting on the main and upper floors. The main floor has a recently renovated kitchen with new stainless-steel appliances, newer light fixtures, a dining room, and living room as well as a private deck. The upper-level features two spacious bedrooms and a full bath, while the lower level includes a fully finished basement that could be used as a family room, office, or storage space and includes a full bath as well as a new hot water heater, new flooring, dryer and a new washing machine. The complex offers two assigned parking spaces with guest parking access. Conveniently located near the Greenwich border and walking distance to Scalzi Park, the home is only 5 to 10 minutes from a shopping center, golf course, dining, and downtown areas.
